title: An import shows nothing until it finishes, so a large one is indistinguishable from a hang — mount a spinner card the moment a file is dropped
description: Requested by the user after a 474 MiB clip took long enough (copy, then a 91s 4K120 HEVC source transcoded to a 720p proxy) that they killed the app mid-import, leaving a 500 MB orphan with no sidecar and no card. Same complaint for a 10 GB LoRA drop, which at least toasts. A drop should mount a placeholder card immediately and swap it for the real media on completion. Reuses the generation placeholder shape the gallery grid already renders (isGenerating + mpi-group-card__spinner), not a new mechanism.
